keyword: what is the college basketball crown
claims: The College Basketball Crown (CBC) is an annual post-season men’s college basketball tournament.
The College Basketball Crown (CBC) was launched in 2025 by FOX Sports and AEG.
The College Basketball Crown is held in Las Vegas.
The College Basketball Crown features teams from Big Ten, Big 12, Big East that did not qualify for the NCAA Tournament.
The College Basketball Crown offers Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) prize money for participants.
The College Basketball Crown was inaugurated in 2025 as a 16-team tournament.
The 2026 edition of the College Basketball Crown is an eight-team, single-elimination format, according to USA Today.
The College Basketball Crown is held on the Las Vegas Strip at T-Mobile Arena and MGM Grand Garden Arena.
The College Basketball Crown generally occurs from late March to early April.
The College Basketball Crown has a $500,000 prize pool in 2026, says USA Today.
The College Basketball Crown focuses on schools from the Big 12, Big Ten, and Big East, along with at-large participants.
The Nebraska Cornhuskers won the first College Basketball Crown tournament in 2025.
All games of the College Basketball Crown are televised on FOX and FS1.
